items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (date of issue/posting) is 17.03.2025, a Monday. The letter states the notice is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after it was given to the post ("gilt am vierten Tag nach dem Tag seiner Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben"), reflecting the post-2025 version of § 122 Abs. 2 AO. Counting from 17.03.2025: day 1 = 18.03., day 2 = 19.03., day 3 = 20.03., day 4 = 21.03.2025 (a Friday, not a holiday) → deemed delivery date = 21.03.2025. The one-month Einspruchsfrist runs per §108 AO / §187 Abs.1, §188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of delivery is not counted, the period starts at the end of 21.03.2025 and ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 21.04.2025. 21.04.2025 is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday in all German Länder including Saarland. Under §108 Abs.3 AO (analogous to §193 BGB), if the last day of the period is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day: 22.04.2025 (Tuesday, not a holiday).
